course.title: SAP S/4HANA & ABAP Cloud Enterprise Engineering
course.description: Comprehensive 100-Day Enterprise Roadmap covering ERP Architecture, Core E2E Processes, In-Memory Data Semantics, Fiori Elements, Clean Core Extensibility, RAP & ABAP Cloud, BTP Integration, and Enterprise Capstone.

phases.title: Enterprise Architecture & ERP Foundations
phases.subtitle: Days 1–8: Enterprise Systems, Organizational Modeling & Core Foundations

phases.title: S/4HANA Fundamentals & Data Architecture
phases.subtitle: Days 9–22: In-Memory HANA Engine, Universal Journal, MATDOC & Landscapes

phases.title: Core End-to-End Business Processes
phases.subtitle: Days 23–44: P2P, O2C, Financial Accounting, Manufacturing & Settlement

phases.title: HANA Engine & Data Semantics
phases.subtitle: Days 45–54: Code Pushdown, Core Data Services (CDS), VDM & Analytical Queries

phases.title: SAP Fiori & Enterprise UX
phases.subtitle: Days 55–64: Fiori Launchpad, SAPUI5, OData Services & Fiori Elements

phases.title: S/4HANA Cloud & Clean Core
phases.subtitle: Days 65–76: Public/Private Cloud, SAP Activate, Extensibility & Data Migration

phases.title: ABAP Cloud & RAP
phases.subtitle: Days 77–89: RESTful Application Programming Model, Behavior Definitions & Actions

phases.title: SAP BTP & Enterprise Integration
phases.subtitle: Days 90–95: Integration Suite, iFlows, Event Mesh & Secure Connectivity

phases.title: Enterprise Capstone
phases.subtitle: Days 96–100: Fit-to-Standard, RAP Implementation, Clean Core Audit & Defense

days.title: Enterprise Systems & Cross-Functional Flows
days.description: Introduction to enterprise computing, business process integration, and modular ERP workflows.
objectives: Understand ERP role in modern enterprises
Trace cross-functional document lineages
Distinguish silos from integrated systems

days.title: Modern SAP Product Portfolio
days.description: S/4HANA, BTP, Signavio, and deployment options (Public, Private, On-Premise).
objectives: Compare S/4HANA Cloud flavors
Understand BTP role in innovation
Position Signavio in process transformation

days.title: Master Data Architecture
days.description: Business Partner (BP), Material Master, Bill of Materials (BOM), and governance.
objectives: Analyze master data lifecycle
Distinguish master vs transactional records
Understand central governance principles

days.title: Organizational Structures in SAP
days.description: Client, Company Code, Plant, Storage Location, Sales Org, and Purchasing Org.
objectives: Model multinational enterprise hierarchies
Map financial vs logistical org units
Configure org unit assignments

days.title: Module Interconnectivity
days.description: Integration touchpoints across FI/CO, MM, SD, and PP.
objectives: Trace cross-module integration triggers
Understand synchronous financial document creation
Analyze automatic account determination

days.title: Technical Architecture Foundations
days.description: Three-tier architecture (presentation, application, database), work processes, spool, background jobs, and gateway.
objectives: Map NetWeaver/ABAP platform architecture
Analyze DIA, BGD, UPD, SPO work process dispatching
Inspect gateway RFC/HTTP communication

days.title: SAP GUI vs Fiori Launchpad
days.description: Comparing classic Dynpro transactions with role-based modern Fiori Launchpad user experiences.
objectives: Navigate classical SAP GUI with transaction codes
Explore role-based modern Fiori Launchpad
Evaluate UX evolution impact on productivity

days.title: Foundation Capstone + Assessment
days.description: Comprehensive assessment of enterprise architecture, org structures, and ERP foundational principles.
objectives: Synthesize multi-entity enterprise organizational structures
Diagnose integration breaks between logistics and finance
Pass Phase 1 benchmark exam

days.title: S/4HANA Value Drivers & Business Case
days.description: Value drivers, simplification journey, real-time analytics, and total cost of ownership reductions.
objectives: Articulate core business drivers for S/4HANA
Contrast batch processing with real-time operations
Evaluate memory cost economics

days.title: ECC to S/4HANA Architectural Changes
days.description: Deconstruction of legacy aggregate and index tables, data model streamlining, and simplification items.
objectives: Analyze simplification list impacts
Examine deprecation of status and index tables
Understand compatibility views

days.title: HANA In-Memory Database Architecture
days.description: Columnar storage, vector processing, delta merge, in-memory caching, and persistence logging.
objectives: Understand column-store vs row-store mechanics
Analyze read/write compression ratios
Trace the delta merge write life-cycle

days.title: ACDOCA & Universal Journal Architecture
days.description: The universal accounting document table: 350+ dimensions, FI/CO unification, multi-GAAP parallel ledgers, and zero reconciliation.
objectives: Explain unification of General Ledger and Controlling
Inspect structural schema of ACDOCA (350+ dimensions)
Trace parallel ledger entries (Leading 0L vs Non-Leading) and multi-currency valuations

days.title: Material Document Architecture (MATDOC)
days.description: Inventory management simplification: elimination of MKPF/MSEG in favor of unified MATDOC table and lock reduction.
objectives: Understand inventory ledger simplification
Contrast legacy hybrid tables with MATDOC
Measure locking contention reduction during goods movement

days.title: Business Partner & Customer-Vendor Integration (CVI)
days.description: Mandatory Business Partner approach, CVI synchronization cockpit, and multi-role assignment.
objectives: Understand mandatory Customer-Vendor Integration
Configure General, Supplier (FLVN00), and Customer (FLCU00) roles
Troubleshoot CVI sync errors

days.title: Core Data Services (CDS) Fundamentals
days.description: Introduction to ABAP Core Data Services: declarative data modeling pushed down to the database.
objectives: Understand code-to-data pushdown philosophy
Write simple DEFINE VIEW ENTITY statements
Compare DDIC views vs CDS View Entities

days.title: DEV / QAS / PRD Landscape Architecture
days.description: Three-system landscape, CTS transport requests, client copy procedures, and release governance.
objectives: Model enterprise development landscapes
Track transport request lifecycles
Formulate release management governance

days.title: Cloud Implementation Landscapes & CBC
days.description: Central Business Configuration (CBC), 2-system vs 3-system cloud landscapes, and provisioning.
objectives: Navigate SAP Central Business Configuration
Analyze Cloud 3-System Landscape (DEV-TEST-PROD)
Configure initial baseline scope

days.title: Identity & Access Governance in S/4HANA
days.description: PFCG authorization roles, catalogs, business users, and IAM integration.
objectives: Design role-based authorization concepts
Map business catalogs to business roles
Enforce segregation of duties (SoD)

days.title: Embedded Analytics Architecture
days.description: Operational reporting directly on transactional tables without traditional ETL data warehouses.
objectives: Understand Virtual Data Model (VDM) in analytics
Configure Smart Business KPIs and Multidimensional Reports
Contrast operational vs strategic reporting

days.title: Document Flow & Cross-Document Traceability
days.description: Trace transactional continuity across sales, delivery, goods issue, invoice, and journal entries.
objectives: Navigate end-to-end document status flows
Investigate relationship tables (VBFA)
Audit clearing account balances

days.title: Cross-Module Integrated Scenario
days.description: End-to-end transactional integration: executing a complete customer order touching BP, Sales, MATDOC Inventory, and ACDOCA Financials.
objectives: Synthesize transactional lifecycle from Business Partner to Financial Journal
Trace cross-table document references between VBFA, MATDOC, and ACDOCA
Resolve simulated posting and ledger clearing discrepancies

days.title: S/4HANA Fundamentals & Architecture Evaluation
days.description: Phase 2 synthesis: evaluating data architecture, table simplifications, and enterprise analytics readiness.
objectives: Defend ACDOCA and MATDOC architectural benefits
Design end-to-end master data and landscape model
Pass Phase 2 benchmark evaluation

days.title: Procure-to-Pay: P2P Overview
days.description: End-to-end procurement lifecycle from requisition to invoice clearing across MM, Inventory, and FI.
objectives: Understand the 6-stage P2P lifecycle
Map procurement organizational units (Client, CC, Plant, Purchasing Org)
Track document flow across EBAN, EKKO, MATDOC, RBKP, ACDOCA

days.title: Procure-to-Pay: Purchase Requisition & Sourcing
days.description: Demand capture, account assignment categories, source determination, and RFQ quotation analysis.
objectives: Create PR with Material/Account Assignment categories
Execute operational sourcing and supplier RFQs
Analyze effective landed price factoring in Incoterms and discounts

days.title: Procure-to-Pay: Purchase Orders
days.description: Purchase order processing, item categories, pricing condition records, and Flexible Workflow approvals.
objectives: Generate Purchase Orders from approved requisitions
Configure multi-level flexible workflows
Inspect pricing conditions and tax codes

days.title: Procure-to-Pay: Goods Receipt
days.description: Goods receipt posting (MIGO / Mov 101), stock types, MATDOC updates, and GR/IR clearing entries.
objectives: Execute MIGO goods receipt against PO
Inspect MATDOC stock updates across stock categories
Verify GR/IR clearing balance in ACDOCA

days.title: Procure-to-Pay: Invoice Verification / 3-Way Match
days.description: Logistics Invoice Verification (MIRO), 3-way matching (PO, GR, Invoice), and tolerance limit checks.
objectives: Perform 3-way match in MIRO
Process price/quantity variance tolerances (PP/DQ)
Investigate Payment Block R and release via MRBR

days.title: Procure-to-Pay: P2P Exceptions & Troubleshooting
days.description: Resolving procurement discrepancies, blocked invoices, returns to vendor (Mov 122), and clearing accounts.
objectives: Resolve invoice price/quantity discrepancy blocks
Process vendor return deliveries and credit memos
Execute GR/IR clearing account maintenance (MR11)

days.title: Order-to-Cash: O2C Overview
days.description: End-to-end sales fulfillment lifecycle, inquiries, quotations, and condition technique pricing.
objectives: Understand the 6-stage O2C lifecycle
Configure condition technique (access sequences, condition types, PR00)
Trace commercial demand to physical delivery

days.title: Order-to-Cash: Sales Orders
days.description: Standard sales order creation (VA01), partner determination (SP/BP/PY/SH), and credit management checks.
objectives: Create sales orders with line item schedules
Execute FSCM customer credit limit checks
Resolve incompletion log flags

days.title: Order-to-Cash: ATP / aATP
days.description: Available-to-Promise check, Product Allocation (PAL), Alternative-Based Confirmation (ABC), and backorder processing.
objectives: Configure advanced ATP confirmation rules
Run Alternative-Based Confirmation across multi-plant networks
Resolve backorder allocation conflicts

days.title: Order-to-Cash: Delivery, Picking & PGI
days.description: Outbound Delivery (VL01N), shipping point determination, warehouse picking (KOSTA), and Post Goods Issue (Mov 601 / COGS).
objectives: Create outbound delivery with automated Shipping Point determination
Confirm warehouse picking and packing status
Post Goods Issue (Mov 601) and analyze COGS inventory reduction

days.title: Order-to-Cash: Billing + FI Integration
days.description: Customer billing (VF01), VKOA revenue account determination, output taxes, and Accounts Receivable updates.
objectives: Generate customer billing documents from deliveries
Configure VKOA account determination for Account Key ERL
Post revenue and sales tax journals to ACDOCA

days.title: Order-to-Cash: O2C Exceptions & Troubleshooting
days.description: Resolving sales fulfillment exceptions, customer returns (RE), credit memos (CR), and billing release blocks (VFX3).
objectives: Diagnose VF051 billing accounting posting blocks in VFX3
Process customer returns and return deliveries (Mov 651/653)
Issue credit memos against billing documents

days.title: Finance: General Ledger
days.description: S/4HANA Universal Journal (ACDOCA), journal entries (FB50), posting keys (40/50), and field status groups.
objectives: Post multi-line general ledger journal vouchers
Control line item field statuses via Field Status Groups
Verify balance sheet and P&L account classifications in ACDOCA

days.title: Finance: Accounts Payable
days.description: Vendor subledger management, line item display (FBL1N), Special G/L indicators, and Automatic Payment Program (F110).
objectives: Manage vendor subledger open items and reconciliation accounts
Post down payments using Special G/L Indicator A
Execute F110 automated payment runs and generate ISO 20022 XML files

days.title: Finance: Accounts Receivable
days.description: Customer subledger management, incoming payments (F-28), bank clearing, and automated dunning runs (F150).
objectives: Post incoming customer payments against open receivables
Clear open customer invoices in ACDOCA
Execute automated multi-level dunning runs in F150

days.title: Finance: Financial Close
days.description: Period-end financial close sequence: depreciation (AFAB), foreign currency valuation (FAGL_FCV), and period locks (OB52).
objectives: Run automated asset depreciation posting runs (AFAB)
Execute foreign currency open-item revaluation (FAGL_FCV)
Lock closing periods and open future periods in OB52

days.title: Inventory Management
days.description: Warehouse movement types (101, 102, 122, 261, 311, 301, 551), single-table MATDOC architecture, and physical inventory.
objectives: Execute SLoc-to-SLoc (311) and Plant-to-Plant (301) stock transfers
Process physical inventory counts, differences, and write-offs
Analyze stock valuation and movement history in MATDOC

days.title: Manufacturing Fundamentals
days.description: Production master data architecture: Bills of Material (CS01), Work Centers (CR01), Routings (CA01), and costing.
objectives: Construct multi-level production BOMs for assemblies
Define Work Centers with capacity and cost center assignments
Establish Routings with standard labor and machine activity times

days.title: Production Execution
days.description: Production order lifecycle (CO01), release, component backflushing (Mov 261), confirmations (CO11N), and FG receipt (Mov 101).
objectives: Create and release production orders from planned orders
Stage components and trigger consumption backflushing (Mov 261)
Confirm operational times (CO11N) and receive finished goods (Mov 101)

days.title: WIP / Variance / Cost Settlement
days.description: Period-end production cost accounting: Work-in-Process (WIP) calculation, variance analysis, and order settlement (KO88).
objectives: Calculate WIP for uncompleted production orders at period close
Compute input price, quantity, and resource usage variances
Execute order settlement (KO88) posting price differences to ACDOCA

days.title: Integrated Cross-Module Enterprise Case
days.description: End-to-end continuous business case: Procurement -> Inventory -> Manufacturing -> Sales -> Finance for Nova Manufacturing.
objectives: Trace complete enterprise chain from PR/PO to finished production and customer billing
Audit financial postings across GR/IR, inventory, COGS, revenue, and settlement
Resolve cross-functional handoff discrepancies across MM, PP, SD, and FI

days.title: Practical Multi-Concept Capstone
days.description: Multi-dimensional benchmark evaluation rigorously testing 18-20 distinct core business process concepts.
objectives: Demonstrate end-to-end cross-module mastery across P2P, O2C, FI, and Manufacturing
Diagnose enterprise process, posting, and configuration exceptions independently
Pass Phase 3 comprehensive capstone evaluation

days.title: HANA Engine Architecture & Internals
days.description: Indexserver, persistence layer, delta merge, code pushdown, PlanViz tracing, and calculation engine optimization.
objectives: Interpret PlanViz execution plans
Analyze delta merge and persistence logging
Optimize code pushdown for in-memory execution

days.title: Virtual Data Model (VDM) Architecture
days.description: SAP VDM design principles: Basic/Interface Views (I_), Composite Views, and Consumption Views (C_).
objectives: Navigate standard VDM hierarchy
Architect reusable Interface Views on raw tables
Build specialized Consumption Views for apps

days.title: CDS Syntax, Expressions & Case Statements
days.description: Field expressions, arithmetic, string functions, coalesce, and complex nested CASE logic in CDS.
objectives: Write advanced conditional logic in CDS
Apply unit and currency conversion functions
Implement date/time transformation expressions

days.title: CDS Associations vs SQL Joins
days.description: Lazy evaluation, on-demand joins, path expressions, and cardinality definitions (1..1, 1..*, 0..1).
objectives: Distinguish eager SQL joins from lazy CDS Associations
Define exact cardinalities for query optimization
Navigate multi-hop path expressions in projections

days.title: Parameterized CDS Views & Session Variables
days.description: Passing input parameters, using $session.user, $session.client, and $session.system_date.
objectives: Define typed input parameters in CDS
Consume environment session variables
Propagate parameters across associated views

days.title: CDS Annotations Catalog
days.description: @Semantics, @Analytics, @EndUserText, and @Consumption metadata governance.
objectives: Apply domain semantics (currency codes, quantities)
Annotate textual descriptions for multi-language support
Configure consumption search and filter behaviors

days.title: CDS View Hierarchies & Compositions
days.description: Parent-child relationships, self-referential hierarchies, and root entity composition definitions.
objectives: Model bill-of-materials and cost center hierarchies
Define composition hierarchies for transactional documents
Enforce referential integrity in CDS

days.title: Analytical Queries: Cubes & Dimensions
days.description: Building analytical cubes (@Analytics.dataCategory: #CUBE) and query views (@Analytics.query: true).
objectives: Construct dimensional models in CDS
Define measures with automated aggregation rules (#SUM, #MAX)
Test analytical multidimensional queries

days.title: Access Control: Data Control Language (DCL)
days.description: Row-level security, DEFINE ROLE statements, PFCG authorization aspects, and tenant isolation.
objectives: Write declarative DCL access rules for CDS entities
Link authorization objects to view fields (e.g. BUKRS)
Test authorization filters in analytical queries

days.title: HANA Engine & Data Semantics Assessment
days.description: Phase 4 benchmark: developing a complete, secure, analytical VDM layer on ACDOCA and MATDOC.
objectives: Build multi-tier VDM composite views with associations
Apply DCL row-level security and analytical annotations
Pass Phase 4 CDS benchmark challenge

days.title: SAP Fiori Design Principles & App Types
days.description: Role-based, adaptive, coherent, simple, and delightful UX; Transactional, Analytical, and Factsheet apps.
objectives: Apply 5 core Fiori design principles
Classify standard apps (Transactional, Analytical, Factsheet)
Evaluate UI modernization benefits

days.title: Fiori Launchpad Configuration: Spaces & Pages
days.description: Configuring modern FLP Spaces, Pages, Sections, Business Catalogs, and Business Groups.
objectives: Build user-centric Spaces and Pages
Assign business catalogs to PFCG authorization roles
Configure tile display parameters and target mappings

days.title: SAPUI5 Framework Architecture
days.description: Model-View-Controller (MVC) pattern, XML views, controllers, two-way data binding, and Component.js.
objectives: Understand SAPUI5 runtime loading
Inspect XML view layouts and controllers
Trace JSONModel and ODataModel data bindings

days.title: OData V2 & OData V4 Protocols
days.description: Entity Data Model (EDM), service metadata documents ($metadata), CRUD-Q operations, and batch requests.
objectives: Inspect OData service metadata definitions
Execute URI query options ($select, $filter, $expand, $top)
Compare OData V2 vs V4 specification enhancements

days.title: Exposing CDS Entities as OData Services
days.description: Methods of exposure: auto-exposure (@OData.publish: true), SADL mapping, and RAP Service Definitions.
objectives: Publish CDS Views as consumable OData services
Register gateway services in /IWFND/MAINT_SERVICE
Inspect service output in SAP Gateway Client

days.title: Fiori Elements Paradigm: Metadata-Driven UIs
days.description: Eliminating custom UI coding: driving frontend application rendering entirely through CDS annotations.
objectives: Understand metadata-driven application architecture
Compare freestyle SAPUI5 vs Fiori Elements development effort
Map CDS UI annotations to screen controls

days.title: UI Annotations: LineItem & SelectionFields
days.description: @UI.lineItem, @UI.selectionField, @UI.headerInfo, and @UI.identification for standard list pages.
objectives: Configure responsive table columns with @UI.lineItem
Build search filter bars using @UI.selectionField
Set title and description header metadata

days.title: Fiori Elements Floorplans: List Report & Object Page
days.description: Constructing standard enterprise apps: List Report for searching/filtering + Object Page for detail viewing.
objectives: Assemble standard List Report application
Build Object Page with header facets and sections
Configure responsive table navigation

days.title: Overview Pages (OVP) & Analytical Cards
days.description: Configuring executive dashboards: List cards, Table cards, Bar chart cards, and KPI tag cards.
objectives: Architect executive Overview Pages
Configure analytic cards driven by analytical CDS views
Setup target mapping navigation from cards

days.title: Enterprise UX Capstone & Security Audit
days.description: Phase 5 benchmark: building and deploying a secure, responsive Fiori Elements app on custom CDS entity.
objectives: Deploy production Fiori Elements app with DCL security
Publish app to custom Fiori Launchpad Space & Page
Pass Phase 5 UX and frontend benchmark

days.title: S/4HANA Cloud: Public vs Private Architecture
days.description: Multi-tenant SaaS (Public Cloud) vs Single-tenant IaaS (Private Cloud), upgrade cycles, and governance.
objectives: Contrast Public Cloud SaaS with Private Cloud Edition
Evaluate release cycle impacts on customization
Analyze total cost of ownership tradeoffs

days.title: The Clean Core Philosophy & Principles
days.description: Zero modifications in standard code, strictly decoupled extensions, upgrade safety, and lifecycle independence.
objectives: Articulate core tenets of Clean Core
Identify technical debt in legacy custom modifications
Formulate Clean Core compliance guardrails

days.title: SAP Activate Methodology & Quality Gates
days.description: Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run; agile governance, deliverables, and Q-Gates.
objectives: Navigate 6 phases of SAP Activate
Manage Quality Gates (Q-Gate 1–4) approval criteria
Execute agile sprints for S/4HANA deployment

days.title: Fit-to-Standard Workshops & Scope Items
days.description: Running Fit-to-Standard discovery: SAP Best Practices scope items, delta identification, and gap cataloging.
objectives: Conduct Fit-to-Standard review of Best Practices
Document functional deltas without custom modifications
Prioritize backlog items using MoSCoW methodology

days.title: Central Business Configuration (CBC)
days.description: Scope definition, organizational structure creation, and fine-tuning deployment via SAP CBC.
objectives: Manage business scope assignment in CBC
Deploy enterprise structures across tenant environments
Execute configuration activities

days.title: Key-User Extensibility (In-App)
days.description: Custom Fields and Logic app, UI field adaptations, custom business logic with restricted ABAP, and email templates.
objectives: Add custom fields to standard applications without coding
Write restricted ABAP validation logic in cloud apps
Adapt standard Fiori screen layouts at runtime

days.title: Developer Extensibility (On-Stack ABAP Cloud)
days.description: Embedded ABAP Cloud in S/4HANA: using ADT, released APIs (C1 contract), and restricted ABAP language version.
objectives: Understand on-stack developer extensibility boundaries
Enforce ABAP Language Version (ABAP Cloud)
Work exclusively with released SAP APIs

days.title: Side-by-Side Extensibility on SAP BTP
days.description: Decoupling custom apps from core ERP: calling public APIs, handling events, and independent lifecycle management.
objectives: Architect side-by-side decoupled extensions
Consume S/4HANA OData APIs from external applications
Ensure zero ERP downtime during extension updates

days.title: Data Migration Cockpit (Migrate Your Data)
days.description: Staging tables, pre-delivered migration objects, data mapping rules, simulation runs, and delta migration.
objectives: Populate migration staging tables
Validate and simulate master data loading
Execute automated reconciliation of migrated records

days.title: Cloud Testing & Regression Automation
days.description: Test Automation Tool for S/4HANA Cloud, quarterly release regression management, and test plan execution.
objectives: Record automated business process test scripts
Execute regression test suites ahead of quarterly upgrades
Manage defect resolution workflows

days.title: Cutover Strategy & Operational Readiness
days.description: Cutover checklists, technical downtime management, blackout windows, and Hypercare stabilization.
objectives: Build minute-by-minute cutover task schedules
Plan blackout windows and transactional cutover sequences
Structure Hypercare support and incident response

days.title: S/4HANA Cloud & Clean Core Assessment
days.description: Phase 6 benchmark: auditing custom code portfolio and designing a Clean Core migration roadmap.
objectives: Classify legacy custom code into In-App, On-Stack, and Side-by-Side tiers
Formulate Activate methodology governance plan
Pass Phase 6 Clean Core benchmark exam

days.title: ABAP Cloud Paradigm & Rules
days.description: Modern ABAP language scope, elimination of obsolete statements, C1 release contract, and zero direct table modifications.
objectives: Enforce ABAP Cloud language restrictions
Identify prohibited legacy statements (CALL TRANSACTION, TABLES)
Verify released API contracts in ADT

days.title: Modern ABAP Objects & ABAP Unit
days.description: Modern syntax (inline declarations, constructor expressions, value operators), OO design, and automated ABAP Unit testing.
objectives: Write modern clean ABAP OO classes
Use VALUE, CORRESPONDING, and COND expressions
Build automated unit test suites with ABAP Unit

days.title: RAP Architecture: The Big Picture
days.description: ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model: Data Model (CDS), Behavior Definition (BDEF), and Service Exposure.
objectives: Map the three architectural tiers of RAP
Understand stateful vs stateless RAP runtime operations
Distinguish managed vs unmanaged implementation types

days.title: RAP Business Object Modeling & Composition
days.description: Root entities, child entities, COMPOSITION OF, and ASSOCIATION TO PARENT relationships.
objectives: Model header-item business objects using CDS view entities
Define compositions for transactional integrity
Establish parent-child navigation paths

days.title: Behavior Definition (BDEF): Managed vs Unmanaged
days.description: Defining behaviors, standard CRUD operations (create, update, delete), and choosing Managed vs Unmanaged scenarios.
objectives: Write declarative BDEF syntax
Choose Managed RAP for greenfield data models
Choose Unmanaged RAP when wrapping legacy BAPIs

days.title: RAP Transactional Buffer & Save Sequence
days.description: Interaction phase vs Save Sequence: finalize, check_before_save, adjust_numbers, save, and cleanup phases.
objectives: Trace lifecycle phases of the RAP transactional engine
Implement validations and determinations at the correct phase
Enforce transactional integrity during the save sequence

days.title: RAP Determinations: on modify vs on save
days.description: Automating business logic: triggering determinations on modify or save to calculate totals, statuses, and keys.
objectives: Implement determinations in behavior implementation classes (BIL)
Configure trigger conditions (field update, creation)
Derive calculated fields automatically

days.title: RAP Validations & Message Handling
days.description: Semantic data validation, populating FAILED and REPORTED structures with %tky target keys and state messages.
objectives: Implement business validations with custom error messages
Populate FAILED and REPORTED response parameters
Bind error messages directly to UI fields

days.title: RAP Actions: Instance, Static & Factory
days.description: Custom business operations: approving documents, releasing orders, and instantiating factory objects via EML.
objectives: Declare custom actions in BDEF with parameter/result signatures
Implement action logic in ABAP behavior pools
Invoke actions via Entity Manipulation Language (EML)

days.title: Draft Handling in RAP
days.description: Draft tables, auto-save state, prepare action, edit drafts, and activating draft records to active tables.
objectives: Enable draft capabilities with 'with draft' in BDEF
Manage draft table lifecycle (creation, editing, discarding)
Implement the PREPARE action for activation validation

days.title: Concurrency Control & Optimistic Locking
days.description: Optimistic locking using ETags (total vs local ETag fields) to prevent concurrent update overwrites.
objectives: Configure @Semantics.systemDateTime.localInstanceLastChangedAt
Implement ETag checks in RAP behavior definitions
Handle lock conflicts gracefully

days.title: Number Ranges & Authorization Control
days.description: Early vs Late Numbering (adjust_numbers) and Global vs Instance authorization checks in RAP.
objectives: Implement Late Numbering using number range objects
Configure Global Authorizations for tenant-level checks
Enforce Instance Authorizations per document status

days.title: ABAP Cloud & RAP Capstone Assessment
days.description: Phase 7 benchmark: building a full Managed RAP Business Object with Draft, Actions, Validations, and OData V4 exposure.
objectives: Implement production-ready RAP Business Object from scratch
Test complete CRUD and Action workflows using OData V4 test tools
Pass Phase 7 benchmark assessment

days.title: SAP BTP Architecture & Runtimes
days.description: Global Accounts, Subaccounts, Entitlements, Cloud Foundry, Kyma (Kubernetes), and BTP Destinations.
objectives: Navigate SAP BTP account hierarchies
Compare Cloud Foundry vs Kyma container runtimes
Configure secure BTP HTTP/RFC Destinations

days.title: Integration Patterns & SAP Integration Suite
days.description: Synchronous vs asynchronous integration patterns, Cloud Integration (CPI), and iFlow architecture.
objectives: Distinguish synchronous and asynchronous integration patterns
Design message processing flows in Cloud Integration
Configure SOAP, OData, and HTTP adapters

days.title: iFlow Mappings & Groovy Scripting
days.description: Message Mapping, Content Enricher, Splitter, Aggregator, and custom Groovy scripting in iFlows.
objectives: Write Groovy scripts for dynamic header and payload manipulation
Configure Content Enrichers to look up master data
Implement error handling sub-processes

days.title: Event-Driven Architecture with SAP Event Mesh
days.description: Asynchronous messaging, Pub/Sub patterns, queues, topics, webhook subscriptions, and CloudEvents standard.
objectives: Understand event-driven architecture benefits in ERP
Configure queues and topics in SAP Event Mesh
Consume CNCF CloudEvents asynchronously

days.title: Secure Connectivity & S/4HANA Event Integration
days.description: SAP Cloud Connector, Destinations, Principal Propagation, and S/4HANA Outbound Events to Event Mesh.
objectives: Configure SAP Cloud Connector for secure hybrid network tunneling
Bind transactional events to BTP Event Mesh topics
Enforce Principal Propagation and destination authentication

days.title: Enterprise Integration Capstone & Challenge
days.description: Phase 8 benchmark: building an event-driven integration pipeline between S/4HANA, Event Mesh, and external webhooks.
objectives: Construct complete event-driven iFlow consuming S/4HANA events
Implement exception routing and retry logic

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: ACDOCA & Universal Journal Foundations
deficiency_triggers: Failed multi-ledger journal entry
Confusion between subledger reconciliation and ACDOCA line items
Missing debit/credit balance principle
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: Understanding ACDOCA

In S/4HANA, the Universal Journal (`ACDOCA`) combines General Ledger (`BKPF`/`BSEG`), Controlling (`COEP`), Asset Accounting (`ANEP`), and Material Ledger (`MLIT`) into a single table with 350+ dimensions.

### Key Invariants:
1. **Zero Reconciliation Needed**: FI and CO are posted simultaneously.
2. **Multi-GAAP**: Leading ledger `0L` reflects group accounting, non-leading ledgers reflect local GAAP.
3. **Real-Time Derivation**: Profit centers and segments are inherited automatically.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: MATDOC & Simplified Inventory
deficiency_triggers: Attempting to query legacy MKPF/MSEG aggregate tables
Confusion over stock locking during goods movement
Failure to understand valuation price variance
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: Understanding MATDOC

In classical ERP, goods movements recorded headers in `MKPF` and line items in `MSEG`, with hybrid locking across material valuation tables.

In S/4HANA, `MATDOC` replaces this architecture with high-speed insert-only columnar records, eliminating lock contention.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: CDS Associations & Path Expressions
deficiency_triggers: Using eager SQL joins instead of on-demand associations
Incorrect cardinality definition causing duplicated aggregation
Syntax errors in path expression traversal
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: CDS Associations vs Joins

Unlike SQL `LEFT OUTER JOIN` which always evaluates eagerly, a CDS **association** is a lazy, on-demand relationship.

Only when an associated element is selected via a path expression (e.g. `_Customer.Country`) is the SQL join generated at runtime by the HANA database engine.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: RAP Transactional Save Sequence
deficiency_triggers: Executing direct database commits (COMMIT WORK) in RAP handlers
Performing side-effects during validations or determinations
Confusion between interaction phase and save sequence
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: The RAP Save Sequence

In RAP, the runtime is strictly split into two phases:

1. **Interaction Phase**: Determinations and Validations run on modify. Changes live in the transactional buffer. NO direct DB writes allowed.
2. **Save Sequence**: Controlled strictly by the RAP framework (`FINALIZE` -> `CHECK_BEFORE_SAVE` -> `ADJUST_NUMBERS` -> `SAVE` -> `CLEANUP`). Never issue a manual `COMMIT WORK`.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Event-Driven BTP Architecture
deficiency_triggers: Using synchronous point-to-point HTTP calls for high-volume decoupled integrations
Missing dead-letter queue or retry handling
Confusion between queues and topic subscriptions
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: SAP Event Mesh & Decoupled Integration

Synchronous REST calls introduce tight coupling and cascading failure risk between ERP and external systems.

With **SAP Event Mesh**, S/4HANA emits a lightweight `CloudEvent` message to a Topic. BTP Queues subscribe to the Topic, guaranteeing at-least-once delivery with store-and-forward reliability.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Organizational Hierarchy & Company Codes
deficiency_triggers: Assigning plants directly to Client instead of Company Code
Confusion between financial entities (Company Code) and logistical entities (Plants)
Misunderstanding centralized vs decentralized Purchasing Organizations
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: Organizational Structure Foundations

In SAP S/4HANA, the **Client** is the highest organizational unit (a self-contained legal/system environment).

- **Company Code (e.g. NM01)**: The smallest organizational unit for which an independent, complete set of financial accounts (Balance Sheet, P&L) is produced.
- **Plant (e.g. PL01, PL02)**: An operational location for manufacturing, storage, or distribution. Plants must ALWAYS belong to a Company Code.
- **Purchasing Organization (e.g. PO01)**: Negotiates procurement terms. Can be assigned across multiple plants for centralized purchasing.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Master Data vs Transactional Data
deficiency_triggers: Classifying Purchase Orders or Sales Orders as master data
Modifying transactional records directly without document flow audit trail
Confusion over central Business Partner (BP) data sharing across roles
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: Master Data Architecture

- **Master Data**: Static, long-lived records shared across all modules (Business Partners, Customers, Suppliers, Material Masters, Bills of Materials, General Ledger accounts).
- **Transactional Data**: Ephemeral, event-driven records created during business transactions (Purchase Requisitions, Purchase Orders, Goods Receipts, Invoices, Sales Orders).

Master data ensures transactional consistency across the entire supply chain.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Cross-Module Integration & Automatic Postings
deficiency_triggers: Failure to recognize that Goods Movement (MIGO) in MM triggers synchronous FI accounting lines
Assuming SD billing requires manual journal entries into General Ledger
Confusion regarding the Goods Receipt / Invoice Receipt (GR/IR) clearing account
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: Cross-Module Document Flow

In S/4HANA, ERP modules do not operate in silos:

1. **Procurement (MM -> FI)**: When a Goods Receipt is recorded (MIGO), inventory is credited/debited and a GR/IR clearing line is posted synchronously to General Ledger.
2. **Sales (SD -> FI)**: When outbound delivery goods issue is posted, inventory decreases and cost of goods sold (COGS) is posted. Billing (VF01) automatically creates accounts receivable in FI.

All integration points rely on **Automatic Account Determination**.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: SAP Three-Tier Client-Server Architecture
deficiency_triggers: Confusing UI presentation layer rendering with application server business logic
Assuming database server executes ABAP business programs directly
Misunderstanding the role of work processes (DIA, BGD, UPD, SPO)
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: SAP Three-Tier Architecture

SAP S/4HANA separates concerns into three distinct layers:

1. **Presentation Layer**: SAP Fiori (browser/mobile) or SAP GUI (desktop). Handles user input, screen rendering, and presentation logic.
2. **Application Layer**: AS ABAP (Application Server ABAP). Executes business rules, orchestrates work processes (Dialog, Background, Update, Spool), and manages transactional buffers.
3. **Database Layer**: SAP HANA In-Memory Database. Stores columnar tables, executes code-pushdown algorithms (CDS views, SQLScript), and ensures ACID persistence.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Modern SAP Product Portfolio
deficiency_triggers: Confusing BTP with the core S/4HANA ERP engine
Not knowing when to use Signavio vs S/4HANA
Confusion between Public Cloud (SaaS) and Private Cloud (IaaS/customizable)
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: Modern SAP Product Landscape

- **SAP S/4HANA**: The digital core ERP system (Finance, Logistics, Manufacturing, Sales).
- **SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform)**: The innovation and extensibility platform (side-by-side apps, integration suite, AI, analytics).
- **SAP Signavio**: Business Process Intelligence (mining, modeling, journey mapping, process simulation).
- **Public Cloud**: Turnkey SaaS with strict standard processes and automatic continuous upgrades.
- **Private Cloud**: Dedicated cloud environment with greater customizing flexibility and legacy code migration paths.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: HANA SQL Optimizer & Execution Pushdown
deficiency_triggers: Fetching large datasets into ABAP memory instead of executing in-engine aggregations
Misinterpreting PlanViz execution operator trees
Triggering un-pushable operations forcing calculation engine row fallback
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: HANA SQL Optimizer & Pushdown

In SAP S/4HANA, the HANA database engine features a cost-based SQL optimizer and specialized execution engines (Column Store engine, Row engine, Calculation engine).

### Optimization Rules:
1. **Push Aggregations & Filters**: Filter at the database level rather than looping in application server memory.
2. **Avoid Engine Hops**: Unnecessary conversion between SQL engine and calculation engine introduces overhead.
3. **Inspect PlanViz**: Analyze dominant operators, table scans, and memory consumption in PlanViz to isolate performance bottlenecks.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Virtual Data Model (VDM) Layering
deficiency_triggers: Creating direct UI consumption views on raw database tables
Violating Clean Core naming conventions and stability contracts
Bypassing reusable interface views in analytical applications
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: S/4HANA Virtual Data Model (VDM)

The SAP VDM structures database entities into three distinct architectural tiers:

1. **Basic/Interface Views (`I_`)**: 1-to-1 projection on standard database tables (e.g. `I_SalesOrder`, `I_Plant`). Stable, enterprise-reusable building blocks.
2. **Composite Views (`R_` / `I_`)**: Combine basic views with associations, calculations, and business aggregations. Model core business entities.
3. **Consumption Views (`C_`)**: Top-level views tailored specifically for applications, analytics, or UI screens. Never accessed by other CDS views.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: CDS Expressions & Conditional CASE Logic
deficiency_triggers: Syntax errors in nested CASE ... WHEN statements
Improper null handling without coalesce
Incorrect unit or currency conversion function signatures in CDS
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: CDS Expressions & Logic

CDS View Entities support rich declarative SQL expressions:

- **CASE Statements**: `case when Condition then Value else Default end as Alias`.
- **Null Protection**: `coalesce(NullableField, FallbackValue)` avoids null propagation.
- **Conversions**: Built-in functions like `currency_conversion(...)` and `unit_conversion(...)` perform in-database standard conversions referencing exchange rate tables (TCURR).

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Parameterized CDS Views & Environment Session Variables
deficiency_triggers: Hardcoding key dates or target currencies in CDS views
Failing to propagate input parameters across associations
Misusing $session environment variables
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: Parameterized CDS Views

Parameterized CDS views allow passing dynamic runtime inputs into database execution:

- **Parameter Syntax**: `with parameters p_target_curr : waers, p_eval_date : abap.dats`
- **Session Variables**: `$session.user`, `$session.client`, and `$session.system_date` inject current runtime context without manual parameter entry.
- **Association Propagation**: Parameters must be passed along associated path expressions using `_Association( p_param: $parameters.p_param )`.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: CDS Annotations Framework & Domain Semantics
deficiency_triggers: Missing @Semantics.amount.currencyCode on financial measure fields
Failure to link quantity fields to unit of measure references
Improper @Analytics data category configuration
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: CDS Annotations & Semantics

Annotations provide semantic metadata consumed by compilers, frameworks, and UIs:

- **Domain Semantics**: `@Semantics.amount.currencyCode: 'CurrencyCodeField'` binds financial numbers to currency references, preventing currency aggregation errors.
- **Quantity Semantics**: `@Semantics.quantity.unitOfMeasure: 'UnitField'` binds quantities to their physical units (e.g. KG, EA).
- **Framework Consumers**: Analytical engines and Fiori Elements rely strictly on these annotations to format tables and charts correctly.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Hierarchical Modeling & Compositions in CDS
deficiency_triggers: Failing to define directory and parent-child association structures in hierarchies
Confusing root entity compositions with loose unmanaged associations
Referential integrity errors in multi-level bill-of-materials
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: CDS Hierarchies & Compositions

- **CDS Hierarchies (`define hierarchy`)**: Model parent-child tree structures (BOMs, cost centers, profit center groups) directly in the HANA database engine, enabling fast recursive traversal.
- **Transactional Compositions (`composition of [0..*] ChildEntity`)**: Establish tight lifecycle ownership between parent and child nodes (e.g. Sales Order Header owns Sales Order Items). When the parent is deleted, child nodes are cascade-deleted.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Multidimensional Analytical Modeling & Cubes
deficiency_triggers: Missing @Aggregation.default: #SUM on numerical measures
Treating dimension views as fact tables
Attempting to query #CUBE views directly from transactional apps without query views
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: Analytical Cubes & Dimensions

In S/4HANA Embedded Analytics, multidimensional reporting follows star/snowflake schemas:

1. **Cube Views (`@Analytics.dataCategory: #CUBE`)**: Hold transactional fact data and measures (e.g. Invoiced Amount, Net Quantity). Every measure MUST declare `@Aggregation.default: #SUM` (or `#MAX`, `#MIN`, `#AVG`). Note: `@DefaultAggregation` is legacy/obsolete terminology.
2. **Dimension Views (`@Analytics.dataCategory: #DIMENSION`)**: Provide master data attributes (Customer, Material, Plant).
3. **Query Views (`@Analytics.query: true`)**: Transient consumption views that project dimensions and measures for execution in analytical tools and KPI cards.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Data Control Language (DCL) & Row-Level Security
deficiency_triggers: Omitting @AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK on CDS entities
Syntax errors in DEFINE ROLE statements and aspect pfcg_auth mappings
Accidental data leakage across company codes or plants
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: DCL Access Control & Security

Data Control Language (DCL) enforces declarative row-level security in the database tier:

1. **Enabling Checks**: View entity must carry `@AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #CHECK`.
2. **Role Definition**: `DEFINE ROLE RoleName { grant select on CDSView where (Plant) = aspect pfcg_auth(M_MATE_WRK, WERKS, ACTVT = '03'); }`.
3. **Transparent Enforcement**: When ABAP or Fiori queries the CDS view entity, the HANA SQL engine automatically injects the PFCG authorization filter into the WHERE clause, preventing unauthorized record disclosure.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Comprehensive Secure VDM Design Synthesis
deficiency_triggers: Architectural fragmentation between CDS views, analytical models, and security rules
Performance degradation due to un-optimized association traversals in consumption queries
Failure to isolate clean core extensibility layers
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: Secure Enterprise VDM Synthesis

A production-grade S/4HANA analytical architecture unifies:

1. **Strict VDM Layering**: Basic -> Composite -> Consumption (naming prefixes like I_, R_, C_ are SAP conventions, but view types are determined by @VDM.viewType annotations).
2. **Association Performance**: Navigation path expressions instantiate joins on-demand; accurate cardinalities ([1..1], [0..1]) govern optimization.
3. **Multidimensional Analytics**: Facts modeled as `#CUBE` with aggregated measures (@Aggregation.default: #SUM), joined with `#DIMENSION` entities.
4. **Security by Design**: Declarative DCL access rules bound to PFCG authorization objects at the database level.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: SAP Fiori Elements Floorplans & UI Annotations
deficiency_triggers: Misunderstanding metadata-driven UI rendering
Confusing List Report with Overview Page
Failure to map OData annotations to UI controls
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: SAP Fiori Elements & OData UX

1. **Metadata-Driven UX**: Fiori Elements applications (List Report, Object Page, Overview Page, Analytical List Page) are not coded imperatively in JavaScript. Instead, the UI structure is generated deterministically from CDS and OData annotations (`@UI.lineItem`, `@UI.identification`, `@UI.selectionField`).
2. **Floorplan Selection**: Use List Report for high-volume searchable items, Object Page for detailed single entity maintenance, and Overview Page for multi-card operational dashboards.
3. **OData V4**: Modern standard with batch operations, sparse fieldsets ($select), and responsive server-side paging.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Clean Core Extensibility Principles
deficiency_triggers: Modifying standard SAP code or database tables directly
Using non-released internal APIs in custom extensions
Improper selection between Key-User, On-Stack Developer, and Side-by-Side extensibility
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: Clean Core Extensibility

1. **Zero Core Modifications**: The digital core must remain standard. Custom tables, custom fields, and extensions must never break standard SAP upgrade cycles.
2. **Extensibility Spectrum**:
   - **Key-User Extensibility**: Low-code in-app additions (Custom Fields and Logic) using restricted ABAP.
   - **Developer Extensibility (On-Stack ABAP Cloud)**: ABAP Cloud in Eclipse ADT strictly calling Released APIs (contract C1).
   - **Side-by-Side Extensibility**: Independent applications running on SAP BTP communicating via OData/REST APIs and events.
3. **Release Contracts**: C1 (system-internal use), C2 (cross-component use), C3 (B2B integration).

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Modern ABAP Cloud & Restricted Syntax
deficiency_triggers: Using forbidden legacy statements (CALL TRANSACTION, direct standard DB writes)
Failing to utilize Released APIs for database and system operations
Lack of automated test coverage with ABAP Unit
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: ABAP Cloud Paradigm

1. **Language Version**: ABAP Cloud enforces Language Version 5 (Standard ABAP Cloud). Legacy statements like `CALL TRANSACTION`, `SELECT * FROM non-released table`, and direct file I/O are compilation errors.
2. **Released APIs**: Only interfaces and classes with Contract C1 can be invoked.
3. **Automated Testing**: ABAP Unit tests are mandatory for cloud compliance, isolating business logic via test seams and mock doubles.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: RAP Behavior Definitions & Transactional Lifecycle
deficiency_triggers: Misunderstanding Managed vs Unmanaged RAP implementation patterns
Executing business modifications in Save phase instead of Determinations or Validations
Improper Draft handling and ETag optimistic locking
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: RAP Architecture & Execution Lifecycle

1. **Dual Phase Lifecycle**:
   - **Interaction Phase**: Read, modify, execute Determinations (`on modify`, `on save`), and Validations. Operates in transactional buffer.
   - **Save Phase**: `finalize`, `check_before_save`, `adjust_numbers`, `save`. Strictly NO external calls or buffer modifications allowed during save.
2. **Managed vs Unmanaged**: Managed RAP delegates CRUD and draft handling to the RAP runtime framework; Unmanaged RAP requires manual ABAP implementation in behavior pool classes.
3. **Draft Enablement**: Preserves temporary user edits in dedicated draft database tables with total ETag concurrency control.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: SAP BTP Integration Suite & Event-Driven Architecture
deficiency_triggers: Designing tight point-to-point connections instead of mediated iFlows
Failing to handle asynchronous enterprise events with SAP Event Mesh
Insecure hybrid connectivity without Cloud Connector or Principal Propagation
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: SAP Integration Suite & Event Mesh

1. **Integration Patterns**: Mediate protocols and data formats using Cloud Integration (CPI) integration flows (iFlows) with Content Enricher, Splitter, and Router patterns.
2. **Event-Driven Architecture**: Decouple publishers and subscribers using SAP Event Mesh with standard CloudEvents JSON payloads.
3. **Secure Connectivity**: Connect On-Premise S/4HANA to BTP via reverse-proxy Cloud Connector, preserving corporate firewall integrity and user context through Principal Propagation.

remediation_capsules.title: Remediation Capsule: Enterprise Architecture Synthesis & Capstone Defense
deficiency_triggers: Architectural misalignment between business requirements and Clean Core compliance
Incomplete document flow and data lineage from CDS to RAP and Fiori UX
Inability to resolve production-down incident scenarios during architectural defense
remediation_capsules.remediation_content_md:
# Remediation: Enterprise Capstone Architecture Synthesis

1. **Discovery & Fit-to-Standard**: Scope standard SAP Best Practices scope items before considering extensions.
2. **Full-Stack Execution**: Model data in CDS View Entities, implement transactional logic in RAP BDEF, expose via OData V4 Service Bindings, and render through Fiori Elements List Report & Object Page.
3. **Enterprise Defense**: Defend architectural choices based on TCO, upgrade agility, response latency, and Clean Core audit metrics.
